name: position-size
description: Descriptive analysis only — not financial advice, and this tool never places an order. Computes a fractional-Kelly position-size multiplier from win-rate/avg-win/avg-loss statistics, a volatility-targeting multiplier, and an asymmetric risk-off de-risking multiplier, plus their product as a single combined multiplier. Use it to size a position you are already considering against your own risk caps, not to decide what to trade.

winRate.description: Fraction of trades that were winners, e.g. 0.55.

avgWin.description: Average winning trade magnitude (positive), as a fraction, e.g. 0.02.

avgLoss.description: Average losing trade magnitude (non-negative; a signed value like -0.015 is rejected), as a fraction, e.g. 0.015.

samples.description: Number of closed trades this edge estimate is based on.

annualizedVol.description: Recent annualised volatility of the position, for volatility-targeting sizing.

targetVol.description: Target annualised volatility. 0 or omitted disables volatility-targeting (1.0x).

riskOffScore.description: Macro risk-off score in [0,1] (fraction of leading indicators firing). Omit for 1.0x (unknown = fail-safe).

config.description: Optional overrides for the sizing curve; see README for defaults.

kellyF.description: Raw Kelly fraction f* = p - (1-p)/R. Negative means no edge.

kellyMult.description: Clamped fractional-Kelly size multiplier. 1.0x if samples < minSamples.

volMult.description: Volatility-targeting size multiplier. 1.0x if targetVol/annualizedVol unknown.

riskOffMult.description: Risk-off de-risking multiplier. 1.0x if riskOffScore is omitted.
